title: Three-Fold Composition with Radicals and Reciprocals
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Write a simplified formula for (f o g o h)(x), given f(x) = sqrt(x + 1), g(x) = 1 / (x + 4), and h(x) = 1 / x.

steps.title: Compute the Inner Composition g(h(x))
steps.explanation: Replace x in g(x) = 1/(x + 4) with h(x) = 1/x, then multiply numerator and denominator by x to clear the nested fraction.
steps.why: Multiplying top and bottom by x != 0 reduces the complex rational expression to standard form.

steps.title: Substitute g(h(x)) into the Outer Function f
steps.explanation: Replace x in f(x) = sqrt(x + 1) with the simplified expression x / (4x + 1).
steps.why: Definition of outer composition with f(u) = sqrt(u + 1).

steps.title: Combine Terms Inside the Radical
steps.explanation: Express the radicand over the common denominator 4x + 1 by adding x and 4x + 1 in the numerator.
steps.why: Combining fractions over a common denominator simplifies the radicand into a single rational expression.
